hook: Your troupe dies on cue: each death fires a Death Scene, and the leads get back up for more.
loop: Each turn, seat Death Scene leads in front, helpers behind them.
Deaths fire Death Scenes twice or more, banking permanent stats and Notices.
Tier 6 replays every scene, raises the cast, or cashes in Notices.

growth.line: From Tier 3, deaths spread permanent stats across the board; Notices add slow, steady growth all game.

feel.early: Encore bodies win fights by refusing to stay down.
feel.mid: Pick an engine: permanent scenes, an Encore wall, or Notices.
feel.late: Placement decides it: who dies first, who dies last.

stars.why: Steps into the dead lead's slot and plays their Death Scene.
Doubles the Death Scenes in front: placement is the decision.
The curtain call: the whole cast gets back up once more.

card_short.u01: Encore: gets back up once with 1 Health.
card_short.u02: Death Scene: +1/+1 to a unit behind, doubled for Understudies.
card_short.u03: Understudy; grows +2/+2 permanently when it steps in.
card_short.u04: When played: fire a friendly unit's Death Scene.
card_short.u05: Pays 1 gold after a fight with 4+ Notices.
card_short.u06: Death Scene: hands Encore to another friendly unit.
card_short.u07: Understudy; leaves a Tail, copies the fallen unit's Death Scene.
card_short.u08: Death Scene: two other friendly units get +1/+1 permanently.
card_short.u09: Units that get back up or step in gain stats.
card_short.u10: Death Scenes of units in front of it fire twice.
card_short.u11: End of Turn: two units grow per 10 Notices.
card_short.u12: Sold units fire their Death Scene and add a Notice.
card_short.u13: Start of Combat: hurts both neighbours, then gives them Attack.
card_short.u14: Encore. Death Scene: your other units +1/+1 permanently.
card_short.u15: Start of Combat: destroys your smallest unit; grows on deaths.
card_short.u16: Death Scene: summons two 3/3 Hatchlings with Encore.
card_short.u17: Last unit dies: every fallen unit gets back up.
card_short.u18: Death Scene: replays every Death Scene from earlier this fight.
card_short.u19: Encore at full Health; +1/+1 for every 2 Notices.
card_short.x01: 3/3 with Encore, from the Compost-Heap Matron.
card_short.x02: 1/1 left by Anguis; its Death Scene grows him.

builds.name: The Repertory
builds.line: Leads in front of the Prompter's Boy; deaths become board-wide permanent stats.

builds.name: The Curtain Call
builds.line: An Encore wall that keeps getting up; Hesketh raises everyone again.

builds.name: The Notices bank
builds.line: Count every death, any tribe's, and cash in for gold and stats.

liked: All three picked Little Anguis: stepping in to play the dead lead's part.
Placement is the decision: the Prompter's Boy doubles whoever stands in front.
worries: Prompter's Boy, Dame Natrix and Old Crest stack Death Scenes fast; needs a sim.
Bill-Poster grows faster every turn as Notices pile up; Žilvinas swings by lobby.
changed: Old Crest capped: once a fight, one replay per unit, never doubled.
Little Anguis leaves a Tail that grows him when it dies.
Toad Claque and Bit-Part Lizard now reward Understudies, tying in the back row.
verdict: For players who like chaining death effects: a readable, familiar game of staged deaths and comebacks.
